saw.short: GTA VI launches in the UK at midnight
saw.headline: *GTA VI* launches in the UK at midnight with a 99 on Metacritic
saw.what: GTA VI goes live in the UK at midnight on Thursday 19 Nov, with a 99 on Metacritic from 150 critic reviews, level with the original Ocarina of Time as the highest-rated game ever, per Metacritic and BBC Newsbeat. Sensor Tower estimates more than 17 million pre-orders. A Belfast school is offering a prize draw for £70 gift cards to get pupils to turn up on launch day.
saw.why: A launch that has taken over feeds and school letters. Today is the peak.
saw.source: Metacritic, 19 Nov; BBC Newsbeat, 18 Nov; Metro, 18 Nov

saw.short: Glastonbury 2027 headliners are Sam Fender, Harry Styles and Billie Eilish
saw.headline: *Glastonbury 2027* headliners: Sam Fender, Harry Styles and Billie Eilish
saw.what: Glastonbury 2027 has named Sam Fender, Harry Styles and Billie Eilish as headliners, with Cher in the Sunday legends slot, per BBC News and NME. Kraftwerk, Massive Attack, Lily Allen and Chase & Status are also on the bill. Tickets were £408, according to the BBC.
saw.why: The biggest UK music announcement of the year. Line-up reaction travels fast.

saw.short: I'm A Celebrity adds late arrival Leigh Francis
saw.headline: *I’m A Celebrity* adds late arrival Leigh Francis
saw.what: Leigh Francis, 53, was due to enter I’m A Celebrity on Wednesday night as a late arrival, with a secret mission first, per Metro and LADbible. Correction: our Tuesday edition said AJ Odudu was sent home, but the show has since told her “all is not as it seems”, and where she is now is unconfirmed. We haven’t seen a report of how Wednesday’s entry went.
saw.why: A show twist keeps fans talking. We’re also correcting Tuesday’s item.

saw.short: Leigh-Anne Pinnock welcomes a baby boy
saw.headline: *Leigh-Anne Pinnock* welcomes a baby boy, with a Celebrity Traitors nod
saw.what: Leigh-Anne Pinnock announced on Instagram on Wednesday that she has had a baby boy, her third child, per Metro, the Mirror and The Independent. Her caption includes a helicopter emoji, a nod to abseiling out of a helicopter in the Celebrity Traitors finale. She hasn’t shared his name.
saw.why: A warm moment tied to a show people loved. The Traitors link made it travel.

saw.short: Hunger Games prequel reviews are mixed to good
saw.headline: *Hunger Games* prequel reviews are mixed to good as UK cinemas open Friday
saw.what: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is at about 72% on Rotten Tomatoes and 55 on Metacritic, with Time Out giving it 4 out of 5, as of Thursday morning. Radio Times says it opens in UK cinemas on Friday 20 Nov. A claim of a one-star Guardian review rests on one blog, so we’ve left it out.
saw.why: A big film week with split critics. Audience reaction will decide the tone.
saw.source: Rotten Tomatoes, 19 Nov; Metacritic; Time Out

platform.short: Snapchat lets creators build Lenses with AI coding assistants
platform.headline: Snapchat lets creators *build Lenses with AI coding assistants*
platform.what: Snap says Easy Lens CLI is free with a Snapchat account and available now, so developers can build Lenses through AI coding assistants they already use. It includes 100+ AR building blocks and 50+ AI asset generators. Snap says it paid $1.8 million to Lens+ creators last month. No countries are listed.
platform.why: Easier Lens building for brands and creators. No region limits stated.
platform.source: Snap newsroom, 18 Nov; Social Media Today, 18 Nov

platform.short: Meta's Creator Dashboard comes to the web
platform.headline: Meta’s *Creator Dashboard* comes to the web
platform.what: Meta says creator tools from Business Suite are now in the Creator Dashboard on the web. They include a new web composer for Feed posts and Reels, bulk video upload, a content library, Instagram insights, inbox and content protection. The blog doesn’t list countries.
platform.why: Posting and reporting for creators in one place on desktop.
platform.source: Meta creators blog, 18 Nov; Social Media Today, 18 Nov

platform.short: Snapchat opens its creator marketplace to beta
platform.headline: Snapchat opens its *AI creator marketplace* to beta
platform.what: Snap says Snap Creator Network, an AI-powered creator discovery tool for advertisers, is now in open beta, and its “Visited By” Snap Map feature is available globally. Snap also announced a two-tier Creator Agency Partner Program. Snap says over 450 million people visit Snap Map every month. Beta regions aren’t stated.
platform.why: Snap is courting agencies and advertisers. Worth a look for creator briefs.
